0022600123.text: Indiana (2-1, second in the Central and 0.5 games back, fifth in the East) visits Milwaukee (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 13th in the East) in the fourth game of the Pacers' season, with the Pacers 2-0 on the road and the Bucks 0-1 at home. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Ivica Zubac is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Indiana lost all four meetings with Milwaukee in 2025-26, most recently 134-123 in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
